title: "Examples"
---

These examples show logos applied to realistic proof scenarios — the kind of properties you might want to guarantee about production code.

- [Number Theory](number-theory.qmd) — parity, polynomial identities, and arithmetic proof search
- [Infinitely Many Primes](infinitely-many-primes.qmd) — Euclid's theorem with divisibility, a least divisor and induction
- [Knights and Knaves](knights-knaves.qmd) — solve and check propositional puzzles
- [Data Structures](data-structures.qmd) — contracts and identities for pure functions
